## Basic Force Graph

Demonstrates the use of [force-graph](https://github.com/vasturiano/force-graph).

<div id="2d-graph"></div>

```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true
ForceGraph = require("//cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/force-graph");

graphdata = FileAttachment("miserables.json").json();

Graph = new ForceGraph(document.getElementById('2d-graph'))
        .graphData(graphdata)
        .width(800)
        .height(800)
        .nodeId("id")
        .nodeAutoColorBy('group')
        .nodeCanvasObject((node, ctx, globalScale) => {
          const label = node.id;
          const fontSize = 12/globalScale;
          ctx.font = `${fontSize}px Sans-Serif`;
          const textWidth = ctx.measureText(label).width;
          const bckgDimensions = [textWidth, fontSize].map(n => n + fontSize * 0.2); // some padding

          ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8)';
          ctx.fillRect(node.x - bckgDimensions[0] / 2, node.y - bckgDimensions[1] / 2, ...bckgDimensions);

          ctx.textAlign = 'center';
          ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
          ctx.fillStyle = node.color;
          ctx.fillText(label, node.x, node.y);

          node.__bckgDimensions = bckgDimensions; // to re-use in nodePointerAreaPaint
        })
        .nodePointerAreaPaint((node, color, ctx) => {
          ctx.fillStyle = color;
          const bckgDimensions = node.__bckgDimensions;
          bckgDimensions && ctx.fillRect(node.x - bckgDimensions[0] / 2, node.y - bckgDimensions[1] / 2, ...bckgDimensions);
        });
```



## 3D Force Graph

Demonstrates the use of [3d-force-graph](https://github.com/vasturiano/3d-force-graph).

<div id="3d-graph"></div>

```{ojs}
//| code-fold: true

selected_node = Inputs.text({label:"Clicked Node", value:""})

function setSelected(v) {
  selected_node.value = v;
}

ForceGraph3D = require("//cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/3d-force-graph");

Graph3 = new ForceGraph3D(document.getElementById('3d-graph'))
      .width(800)
      .height(800)
      .graphData(graphdata)
      .nodeAutoColorBy('user')
      .nodeLabel((node) => {return `${node.id}: ${node.group}`})
      .onNodeClick((node) => {
        setSelected(node.id);
      });
```
